column1: # The identity specs' seconds in the landing check's identity shards, from one run under one load (precommit-check run
# 41616356612, 2026-11-03, ci-metrics `suite` lines: the slowest of each shard), so they compare with each other; a part
# of a real-family spec (SliceParts) that run did not list weighs its listed parts' mean, and the small rows it did not
# list are kept from runs 41611692664 / 41389472643. Only shard_tests.py's balance reads them: a missing or stale row
# moves a class to another shard, never out of the check (an unknown class weighs 3).
# TitleRelationPart1-4: that run's seconds x 0.2 (2026-11-03: the spec reads each listing's title forms once per slice, not
# three times per related pair; laptop 490 -> 91 cpu-s over every slice), Part1 + 24 s of its whole checks.
